name: prof-f05-guinness — extracted from f05-guinness
palette: High-contrast black-and-white with deep blacks, bright whites, and minimal midtones to emphasize texture and elemental forces.
light_logic: Harsh, directional natural light on faces and water; underwater glow from above; occasional near-dark frames to punctuate the journey.
lens: Tight portrait lenses for facial close-ups, wider lenses in the water for dynamic wave and body distortion, with stable, deliberate framing.
texture: Emphasis on skin pores, wrinkles, spray, bubbles, and foam; grainy, tactile surfaces that make water and weather feel physically present.
world: A stripped-back, almost mythic seascape where a lone figure and the ocean are the only characters, existing outside specific time or place.
forbidden: fast-cut montage of many different people
